Fuseaux lungo

W2913 SPEED RUN

Taglia:
Descrizione
La nostra classica calzamaglia elasticizzata ideale per un uso con temperature più rigide. Questo capo è progettato per offrire il massimo comfort e la massima flessibilità durante le tue corse. Il tessuto elasticizzato segue ogni tuo movimento, consentendoti di correre con una libertà di movimento totale. La vestibilità aderente e la costruzione leggera ti permettono di concentrarti solo sulla tua corsa, senza distrazioni. La traspirabilità avanzata mantiene la tua pelle fresca e asciutta, mentre il tessuto resistente assicura che questa calzamaglia sarà il tuo compagno di running affidabile per molte stagioni a venire. Personalizzabile sulle bande laterali con i colori del tuo team.

Taglia:
Descrizione
Affronta le giornate più fredde con stile e comfort grazie alla nostra maglia termica a maniche lunghe con zip corta. Realizzata con materiali tecnici di alta qualità, questa maglia ti terrà al caldo durante le tue corse invernali. La zip corta consente di regolare la ventilazione per una corsa sempre perfetta. Inoltre, il tessuto trasporta efficacemente il sudore verso l'esterno, garantendo un comfort ottimale durante l'utilizzo. Che tu stia allenandoti in città o sulla pista, questa maglia è la scelta ideale per i runner che cercano prestazioni elevate e uno stile inimitabile.

Descrizione
Questi fuseaux a 3/4 sono costruiti per durare, resistendo ai rigori degli allenamenti e delle gare, e sono perfetti per la mezza stagione. Realizzati con un materiale speciale, eccellono nel trasporto rapido ed efficiente del sudore, assicurandoti di rimanere caldo e asciutto, sia nel bel mezzo dell'attività che dopo la corsa. La composizione e la lavorazione artigianale del tessuto garantiscono una vestibilità ottimale e duratura. La personalizzazione è fondamentale: aggiungi un tocco personale con i loghi e i colori della tua squadra sulle bande laterali. Descrizione
Vi presentiamo i nostri pantaloncini da corsa 2 in 1 da donna, una fusione di prestazioni e versatilità. Questi pantaloncini sono progettati con uno strato di compressione integrato che fornisce supporto e copertura eccezionali per un'esperienza di corsa ottimale. Realizzati in tessuto bielastico di alta qualità offrono flessibilità e facilità di movimento. Lo strato di compressione interno non solo migliora la stabilità ma garantisce anche una vestibilità sicura e confortevole. Il trattamento antibatterico mantiene un ambiente igienico, permettendoti di concentrarti sulla corsa senza distrazioni. Caratterizzati da un design accurato sono dotati di tasche posteriori con cerniera per riporre comodamente gli oggetti essenziali. Le bande laterali stampate offrono un'opportunità unica di personalizzazione, consentendo di personalizzarle con loghi e colori della squadra.

      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 92%, #f46b78 92% 100%),
        linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 86%, #f46b78 86% 100%);
      opacity: .9;
    }

    .shirt-england::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 44%;
      height: 8%;
      border-bottom: 4px solid #22304e;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
      border-right: 3px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 0 0 18px 18px;
      z-index: 2;

    .shirt-brazil {

        linear-gradient(180deg, #0f1b34 0%, #071221 100%);

    .shirt-brazil::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(31,97,245,.85) 0 3px, transparent 3px 16px),

    .short-dark { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0d152d 0%, #08101d 100%); }

    .crest, .swoosh, .j-logo, .star, .text-badge {
      position: absolute;

    .crest {

  langToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

    langDropdown.classList.toggle('open');

  document.addEventListener('click', () => langDropdown.classList.remove('open'));

  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');

  const langToggle = document.getElementById('lang-toggle');
  const langDropdown = document.getElementById('lang-dropdown');
  langToggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    langDropdown.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', () => langDropdown.classList.remove('open'));

  // MOBILE NAV
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobile-nav');

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    :root {
      --black: #0a0a0a;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --off-white: #f4f4f2;
      --grey-100: #e8e8e6;
      --grey-300: #b0b0aa;
      --grey-500: #6e6e68;
      --grey-700: #2e2e2a;
      --grey-800: #1c1c18;
      --accent: #ffffff;
      --nav-h: 80px;
      --topbar-h: 36px;
    }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--black);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
    img, video { display: block; }

    /* ─── ANNOUNCEMENT BAR ─── */
    .topbar {
      height: var(--topbar-h);
      background: var(--black);
      color: var(--white);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .topbar a {
      color: var(--white);
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 2px;
    }

    .topbar-right {
      position: absolute;
      right: 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    /* ─── NAV ─── */
    .nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      height: var(--nav-h);
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 200px 1fr 200px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 32px;
      transition: background 0.3s ease;
    }

    .nav-logo img {
      height: 56px;
      width: auto;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 36px;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-links a {
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--grey-700);
      transition: color 0.2s;
      padding: 4px 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-links a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -2px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--black);
      transition: width 0.25s ease;
    }

    .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--black); }
    .nav-links a:hover::after { width: 100%; }

    .nav-actions {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .lang-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--grey-700);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: color 0.2s;
      background: none;
      border: none;
    }

    .lang-btn:hover { color: var(--black); }

    .lang-btn img {
      width: 18px;
      height: 12px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: 2px;
    }

    .lang-dropdown {
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      right: 0;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--black);
      min-width: 140px;
      border: 1px solid var(--grey-100);
      z-index: 200;
      display: none;
    }

    .lang-dropdown.open { display: block; }

    .lang-dropdown a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--black);
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .lang-dropdown a:hover { background: var(--grey-100); }
    .lang-dropdown img { width: 18px; height: 12px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 2px; }

    .lang-wrap { position: relative; }

    /* ─── MOBILE NAV ─── */
    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 22px;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--black);
      transition: all 0.3s;
    }

    .mobile-nav {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: var(--black);
      z-index: 200;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open { display: flex; }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;
      font-size: 36px;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .mobile-close {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      right: 28px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 28px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      :root { --nav-h: 56px; --topbar-h: 32px; }
      .nav { grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr auto; padding: 0 20px; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .topbar { font-size: 11px; padding: 0 16px; }
      .topbar-right { display: none; }
    }

    body {
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button {
      font: inherit;
      background: none;
      border: 0;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* TOP BAR */
    .ui-topbar{
      height: 30px;
      background: #0a0a0a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 34px 0 60px;
    }

    .ui-topbar-left{
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .ui-topbar-left button{
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      fill: #fff;
    }

    .ui-topbar-right{
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .ui-topbar-right a{
      color: #fff;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    .ui-topbar-right .sep{ opacity: .6; }

    /* NAV BIANCO */
    .ui-nav-white{
      height: 96px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg,#ffffff,#f8f8f8,#ffffff);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 40px;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 50;
    }

    .ui-nav-white .ui-logo{
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    
    .ui-nav-white .ui-nav-center{
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 34px;
    }

    .ui-nav-white .ui-nav-center a{
      color: #000;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .ui-nav-white .ui-nav-right{
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .page {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 100vh;
    }

    .top-strip {
      height: 40px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #dedede;
      background: #f6f6f6;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 18px 0 14px;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .top-strip-left,
    .top-strip-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .top-strip-left .mini-icon {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #111;
      opacity: .92;
    }

    .divider {
      color: #b7b7b7;
      font-size: 12px;
    }

    .top-strip-right a {
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .main-header {
      height: 112px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr 320px;
      align-items: start;
      padding: 18px 28px 0 28px;
      background: white;
    }

    .brand {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      padding-top: 4px;
    }

    .brand-mark {
      width: 46px;
      height: 18px;
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
      transform: skewX(-18deg) rotate(-8deg);
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #111 0%, #111 60%, transparent 61%);
      border-radius: 100% 0 70% 0 / 100% 0 80% 0;
      clip-path: polygon(0 70%, 12% 55%, 35% 40%, 60% 23%, 100% 0, 68% 40%, 28% 78%, 0 100%);
      margin-left: 4px;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .nav-center {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 34px;
      padding-top: 2px;
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .nav-center a {
      font-size: 18px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }

    .header-right {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      padding-top: 0;
    }

    .search {
      width: 181px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--soft);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      color: #757575;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    .header-icon {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #111;
    }

    .promo-bar {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      margin-top: 18px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--promo);
      border-top: 1px solid #efefef;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 60px 1fr 60px;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 10px;
    }

    .promo-arrow {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #888;
    }

    .promo-content {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 18px;
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #111;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .promo-content strong {
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .promo-content a {
      text-decoration: underline;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .catalog-shell {
      padding: 18px 32px 0 32px;
    }

    .catalog-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .catalog-title {
      font-size: 26px;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .toolbar-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
      font-size: 17px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .toolbar-action {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: #111;
    }

    .catalog-layout {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 216px minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: 24px;
      align-items: start;
    }

    .filters {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      padding-right: 6px;
    }

    .filter-scroll {
      height: 437px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding-right: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      scrollbar-width: auto;
      scrollbar-color: #777 #fff;
    }

    .filter-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar {
      width: 8px;
    }

    .filter-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: #fff;
    }

    .filter-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      background: #737373;
      border-radius: 999px;
    }

    .category-link {
      display: block;
      font-size: 15px;
      line-height: 1.45;
      padding: 3px 2px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .category-link.multi {
      max-width: 165px;
    }

    .filter-group {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
      padding: 18px 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .products-area {
      min-width: 0;
    }

    .products-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .card {
      min-width: 0;
      margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .card-image {
      background: #f0f0f0;
      aspect-ratio: 0.98 / 1;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .card-image.third {
      background: #f0f0f0;
    }

    .wishlist-edit {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      width: 42px;
      height: 42px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.95);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.08);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .product-photo {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      display: flex;
      background: #f0f0f0;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .figure {
      position: relative;
      width: 62%;
      height: 94%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .head {
      position: absolute;
      top: 6%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 18%;
      height: 12%;
      border-radius: 50% 50% 48% 48%;
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .neck {
      position: absolute;
      top: 15.5%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 5.2%;
      height: 4%;
      border-radius: 6px;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .torso {
      position: absolute;
      top: 18%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 44%;
      height: 41%;
      border-radius: 18% 18% 10% 10% / 12% 12% 8% 8%;
      z-index: 2;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .arm {
      position: absolute;
      top: 22%;
      width: 12%;
      height: 34%;
      border-radius: 40px;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .arm.left { left: 22%; transform: rotate(8deg); }
    .arm.right { right: 22%; transform: rotate(-8deg); }

    .forearm {
      position: absolute;
      width: 10%;
      height: 25%;
      border-radius: 40px;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .forearm.left { left: 18%; top: 44%; transform: rotate(2deg); }
    .forearm.right { right: 18%; top: 44%; transform: rotate(-2deg); }

    .hand {
      position: absolute;
      width: 7%;
      height: 6%;
      border-radius: 50%;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .hand.left { left: 15.5%; top: 67%; }
    .hand.right { right: 15.5%; top: 67%; }

    .leg {
      position: absolute;
      top: 54%;
      width: 13.5%;
      height: 34%;
      border-radius: 40px 40px 22px 22px;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .leg.left { left: 37%; }
    .leg.right { right: 37%; }

    .model-1 .head,
    .model-1 .neck,
    .model-1 .arm,
    .model-1 .forearm,
    .model-1 .hand,
    .model-1 .leg { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2419 0%, #2f1a12 100%); }

    .model-2 .head,
    .model-2 .neck,
    .model-2 .arm,
    .model-2 .forearm,
    .model-2 .hand,
    .model-2 .leg { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #6c432e 0%, #4d2f21 100%); }

    .model-3 .head,
    .model-3 .neck,
    .model-3 .arm,
    .model-3 .forearm,
    .model-3 .hand,
    .model-3 .leg { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8b5d46 0%, #6f4735 100%); }

    .hair-short {
      position: absolute;
      top: 5.5%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 20%;
      height: 6.5%;
      background: #141414;
      border-radius: 50% 50% 38% 38%;
      z-index: 4;
    }

    .hair-braids {
      position: absolute;
      top: 4%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 23%;
      height: 14%;
      z-index: 4;
    }

    .hair-braids::before,
    .hair-braids::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 12%;
      width: 18%;
      height: 78%;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, #241814 0 5px, #4d362d 5px 8px);
      border-radius: 18px;
    }

    .hair-braids::before { left: 16%; transform: rotate(5deg); }
    .hair-braids::after { right: 16%; transform: rotate(-5deg); }

    .hair-braids span {
      position: absolute;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      top: 0;
      width: 66%;
      height: 44%;
      background: #231815;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: block;
    }

    .shirt-france {
      background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(35,92,214,.95) 0 3px, transparent 3px 10px),
        radial-gradient(circle at 62% 18%, rgba(28,61,170,.85), transparent 26%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 32% 44%, rgba(17,44,123,.9), transparent 28%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #183988 0%, #0c2258 100%);
    }

    .shirt-france::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 41%;
      height: 11%;
      background: #f4f4f4;
      clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 78% 100%, 22% 100%);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .shirt-france::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 6.4%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 8%;
      height: 9%;
      background: #cf1e3e;
      clip-path: polygon(45% 0, 55% 0, 58% 100%, 42% 100%);
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .shirt-england {
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f6f6f6 100%);
    }

    .shirt-england::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 0 92%, #f46b78 92% 100%),
        linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 86%, #f46b78 86% 100%);
      opacity: .9;
    }

    .shirt-england::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      width: 44%;
      height: 8%;
      border-bottom: 4px solid #22304e;
      border-left: 3px solid transparent;
      border-right: 3px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 0 0 18px 18px;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .shirt-brazil {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 24%, rgba(17,47,131,.18), transparent 20%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #0f1b34 0%, #071221 100%);
    }

    .shirt-brazil::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        repeating-linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(31,97,245,.85) 0 3px, transparent 3px 16px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31,97,245,.14) 0 28%, transparent 28% 72%, rgba(31,97,245,.14) 72% 100%);
      opacity: .95;
    }

    .short-blue { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0d1e49 0%, #0a1634 100%); }
    .short-white { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fbfbfb 0%, #f0f0f0 100%); }
    .short-dark { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0d152d 0%, #08101d 100%); }

    .crest, .swoosh, .j-logo, .star, .text-badge {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 3;
    }

    .crest {
      width: 12%;
      height: 14%;
      right: 16%;
      top: 17%;
      border-radius: 4px 4px 8px 8px;
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.18);
      backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
    }

    .crest.eng {
      right: 18%;
      top: 18%;
      background: #f5f5f5;
      border: 1.5px solid #22304e;
    }

    .crest.bra {
      right: 38%;

    }

    .swoosh {
      left: 18%;
      top: 21%;

      height: 4%;
      background: currentColor;

      clip-path: polygon(0 60%, 18% 42%, 50% 20%, 100% 0, 68% 35%, 25% 70%, 0 100%);
    }

    .swoosh.pink { color: #d96f8d; }
    .swoosh.black { color: #111; }

    .j-logo {
      left: 19%;
      top: 18%;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #ffcf32;
      font-size: 24px;
    }

    .star {
      top: 11.5%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: #ffcf32;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 2px;
    }

    .text-badge {
      right: 34%;
      top: 31%;
      color: #ffcf32;
      font-size: 11px;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
    }

    .legs-hands-on-hips .forearm.left {
      left: 14%;
      top: 45%;
      transform: rotate(38deg);
      height: 22%;
    }

    .legs-hands-on-hips .forearm.right {
      right: 14%;
      top: 45%;
      transform: rotate(-38deg);
      height: 22%;
    }

    .legs-hands-on-hips .hand.left {
      left: 9.5%;
      top: 59%;
    }

    .legs-hands-on-hips .hand.right {
      right: 9.5%;
      top: 59%;
    }

    .swatches {
      display: flex;
